title: Sr Coordinator, Training & Quality ( Customer Service Insights)
Data Quality Specialist - Installed Base & Entitlement
Field Application Engineer
description:
1\. Project Execution.
 



 •Scheduling of project task as per WBS and assigned resources. Co\-ordination with PM/TM/Tech lead of project for faster and better execution.
 



 • Review of off\-site development work, functional testing including integration of various hardware/software components.
 



 • Conduct Pre\-FAT and FAT.
 



 •Supervision of panel manufacturing, hardware configuration, prepare setup for Internal FAT/Customer FAT.
 



 • Application development on PLC or SCADA platform as per guidance of Lead Engineer / Technical Manager / Project Manager.
 



 • Site execution planning with all required manpower, tools and resources at site. Ensure there is no delay due to non\-availability of resources (i.e., tools, additional hardware, software required for installation/commissioning) at site.
 



 • Deployment of solution (hardware/software) at customer site, testing and commissioning of program as an individual or within team.
 



 •Providing support to customer as an when assigned under guidance of Lead engineer / Technical Manager.
 



 •Customer Interaction for technical deliverables (TM and PM should always be in loop)
 



 2\.Documentation
 



 •Preparing/Approval of project documentation as per requirement i.e., GA Drawing, Wiring Drawing, FAT/SAT procedure, Manuals etc. Updating document.
 



 •Maintaining Project Backup as designated locations.
 



 • Create SOP/Technotes on troubleshooting/maintenance guidelines, site specific configurations.
 



 3\. Compliance, Reporting \& Training
 



 •Adherence to Reporting process in Timesheet, Meeting requirements of Work, maintaining discipline at workplace and customer site, Maintaining Integrity \& confidentiality
 



 Daily reporting of on\-site/Off\-site project activity to Lead Engineer /PM/TM.
 



 •
 



 Self\-Training (Function/Cross Functional) to be Targeted and Achieved ( Online/Off line Certifications)
